verdict.rationale: Twenty is a CRM platform, not an agent, so an official MCP server is a fair axis. Its pricing page lists "MCP server" as included on every plan, but that table row is the only evidence. Missing for 10: documentation on connecting an agent to the MCP server, which tools or objects it exposes, how authentication and permission scoping work for MCP clients, and independent or hands-on corroboration that it works.
